description: This source file defines the TransactionRecoveryTestsRunner class, which is responsible for running and validating transaction recovery tests in an Orleans-based distributed system. It includes methods for simulating silo failures, coordinating transaction execution, and verifying consistency of grain states after recovery.

classes.name: TransactionRecoveryTestsRunner
classes.description: A test runner class for executing and validating transaction recovery scenarios in Orleans, including silo shutdowns and recoveries, with methods to coordinate grain transactions and verify state consistency.

classes.name: ExpectedGrainActivity
classes.description: A helper class representing the activity state of a transactional grain during tests, including methods to retrieve actual grain state.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message with timestamp and writes to test output and logger.

methods.name: TransactionWillRecoverAfterRandomSiloFailure
methods.description: Performs a test where a silo is shut down (gracefully or ungracefully) during transactions and verifies recovery.

methods.name: WakeupGrains
methods.description: Activates a list of grains by pinging them.

methods.name: RunWhileSucceeding
methods.description: Runs transactions repeatedly until failure or external stop signal.

methods.name: CheckTxResult
methods.description: Checks transaction results and verifies system recovery.

methods.name: RunAllTxReportFailed
methods.description: Runs all transactions and reports which failed.

methods.name: SetBit
methods.description: Sets a bit in grains via a transaction coordinator, handling exceptions.

methods.name: ValidateResults
methods.description: Validates that grain states match expected values after transactions.
